prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1059; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me stopped suddenly, and I braked as hard as I could. The vehicle coming the other way drifted over the center line and struck the front of my car. Neither of us was moving fast, but the impact pushed my head forward and then back against the headrest. Within a few hours I had stiffness and a dull ache across my neck and lower back, and I have been sore since. I have given the same description of what happened to the adjuster, to the police officer at the scene, and to my doctor, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating my own vehicle at the time. I am asking that this claim be reviewed so that my medical treatment and vehicle repairs can be covered.
